**New name in the stores:** Detour: YouTube videos where you subscribe. The toolbar and popup still say Detour.

### Changed
- Detour now works with six platforms (Nebula, Floatplane, ClockwiseTV, 2nd try, WatcherTV and Beacon), too many for the store name, so the name no longer lists them. The store summary and description still name every platform.

Nothing else has changed since [0.8.0](https://github.com/josh345rtfvqw/detour/releases/tag/v0.8.0).

**Install:** [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/detour/lofobnkomhhicgcpejnlcibekkaiaeed), [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/detour-nebula-floatplane/), or load the zip below.
